summary.headline: Canara Robeco AMC Q2 FY27 revenue from operations rose 17% YoY to INR 121.6 crores and PAT rose 21% to INR 59.2 crores.
summary.overview: Q2 FY27 revenue from operations grew 17% YoY to INR 121.6 crores and PAT grew 21% to INR 59.2 crores, with H1 PAT up 23% to INR 134.8 crores. Closing AUM was INR 1.17 lakh crores, with September quarterly average AUM up 4% YoY, while management described the quarter as challenged by a roughly 6% Nifty fall in September. The company declared an interim dividend of INR 2 per share. Management did not disclose net flows, and analysts questioned SIP book and folio trends, which management attributed to ELSS tax-law changes, vintage SIP maturities, and market-driven closures.
